cdvqa_reconciled_statistics.evaluation_split: Held-Out Test Set 1 (39,686 questions, 968 scene pairs)
cdvqa_reconciled_statistics.statistical_test_scope: Paired tests are nominal seed-level Student's t-tests across 3 seeds (df=2) comparing the in-house FeatureVQAHead against the in-house BlindVQAHead. Predictions for the 39,686 test questions are clustered within 968 scene pairs and are not independent observations.

isro_sac_cross_modal_status.target_sensors: Cartosat-2S High-Resolution Optical + RISAT-1 C-Band SAR

published_sota_comparisons.sota_model: Dual-ResNet Baseline (68.45% OA, 42.10% AA) / ResNet-101+CEM (69.03% OA, 60.08% AA)
published_sota_comparisons.finding: Identical test questions (39,686) and 19-class vocabulary. Displays arithmetic delta of +0.59% OA over published Dual-ResNet and +0.01% over ResNet-101+CEM. No external hypothesis test (p-value) is claimed because baseline prediction arrays were not published.

published_sota_comparisons.sota_model: ResNet-152 + LSTM Baseline (Sylvain Lobry et al., IEEE TGRS 2020)
published_sota_comparisons.finding: Evaluated on 2,000-question validation subset across 100 scenes. Lobry et al. evaluated on the full corpus. This is a validation result, not an independent test score. Independent geographic transfer is evaluated on the 20-scene disjoint test partition (64.07% OA).

published_sota_comparisons.satquery_result: 31.44% Macro Change IoU, 55.08% 2-Class mIoU, 81.93% Pixel Acc
published_sota_comparisons.sota_model: FC-Siam-diff (Daudt et al., 2018 / Yang et al., 2021) / SNUNet (Fang et al., 2021)
published_sota_comparisons.published_result: ~15%-20% Change IoU (FC-Siam-diff) / ~32%-36% Change IoU (SNUNet on SECOND)
published_sota_comparisons.finding: Evaluated on all 968 authentic held-out SECOND pairs. Literature numbers reflect qualitative contextual ranges under varied semantic vs binary transfer protocols.

GeoChat Acc@0.5 evaluates bounding box IoU >= 0.50. SatQuery Center Precision @0.50 evaluates center point distance within normalized threshold. Metrics are mathematically distinct and cannot be directly compared.
SatQuery evaluates strict exact string matching on CPU with lightweight classifier head; GeoChat 7B uses autoregressive generative decoding with relaxed answer matching.

published_sota_comparisons.sota_model: LoveDA (Wang et al., 2021) / BigEarthNet-MM (Sumbul et al., 2021)
published_sota_comparisons.finding: Sensor and task mismatch: LoveDA is optical-only in China; BigEarthNet-MM reports 19-class patch classification mAP, not dense pixel segmentation. This is NOT an ISRO/SAC benchmark result.
